title: resend_grpc input
description: Input schema for the resend_grpc tool (RFC-001 N8 typed gRPC resend).

flow_id.description: Recorded gRPC stream id; when set, omitted Start fields and the encoding hint are inherited.

target_addr.description: Upstream host:port. Required when flow_id is empty. Redirects dial target while preserving :authority when supplied with flow_id.

scheme.description: Defaults to https. http selects plaintext h2c.

service.description: gRPC service name (e.g. pkg.Greeter). Required when flow_id is empty.

method.description: gRPC method name (e.g. SayHello). Required when flow_id is empty.

metadata.description: Ordered metadata list; preserves wire case, order and duplicates.

messages.description: Request-side LPM list; at least one element required.

body_encoding.description: text (default) | base64 | proto-schemaless-json. proto-schemaless-json re-encodes via internal/encoding/protobuf (USK-922).

compressed.description: Set the LPM compression flag; requires encoding to be set.

trailer_metadata.description: Optional Send-direction trailer HEADERS; when supplied, the request terminates via a trailer frame instead of END_STREAM on the last DATA.

tag.description: Tag stored on the new flow's Tags map.
